iterations.name: Threads
iterations.description: Each comment is the main unit.
iterations.rationale: Structure the sidebar around individual comments. Keep the variant, target, message, and agent receipt together so feedback is readable without expanding a submission.

iterations.name: Batches
iterations.rationale: Structure feedback by explicit submission. One receipt belongs to the whole package, and earlier batches collapse while retaining a visible disclosure.

iterations.name: Activity
iterations.description: Follow the review as a sequence of events.
iterations.rationale: Structure feedback chronologically. Put submission, comment content, and agent receipt in one continuous feed with fewer filled containers.
